verdict.rationale: Supervising coding agents is a fair question for an AI assistant, but the evidence shows nothing of the kind. Khoj's GitHub integration only indexes repositories for search and chat. Its code execution runs simple Python for data analysis and plots, and its 'agents' are custom system prompts and personas. None of these are cloning, editing or testing a repo, so they are adjacent features only.

support.subject: As a developer, the assistant can supervise or embed real coding agents so it does repo work — cloning, editing, testing — not just snippets in chat
